rawEvidencePolicy: Store consent records and raw session material in a private operator-controlled system; commit only anonymized aggregate evidence IDs and signed summaries.

householdPilot.purpose: The realistic first step for a family service of about five readers (codex audit F23, 2026-10-15): observe the real readers on their own devices before any recruited study. It does not replace or lower minimumStudy; it never sets certification.
householdPilot.record: Per task: completed, where the reader hesitated or misread, device, date. Anonymized aliases only; raw notes stay private.

acceptance.statisticalBasis: v57.84 review: 5 participants per persona is a usability-discovery size (finds most severe problems), not a sample that can estimate a rate. With 5 readers, one critical misunderstanding is already 20%, so the 5% ceiling means zero observed per persona, and a 90% completion rate over 30 task attempts has a wide interval. Report counts with the attempts behind them; read a pass as 'no severe problem observed in this group', never as a measured population rate.

reason: Automated browser checks and expert review are not recruited-user or assistive-technology evidence. No session is promoted without signed, anonymized evidence.
